document.title: Standard Test Methods for Rating Portal Stability of Enchanted Moon-Glass

test_items.description: Resistance to whisper loss and apparent hue change during controlled paired-portal transit.

evidence.quote: resistance of enchanted moon-glass vessels to loss of stored whisper content and change in apparent hue

methods.name: Single-Whisper Transit Test
methods.applicability: A single ordered whisper imprint in similarly charged moon-glass vials.

evidence.quote: Set the transit rings to fringe setting 4
a transit duration of 2.0 +/- 0.1 s in each direction
after 30 +/- 2 s, return it through the paired ring
allow the specimen to recover for 10.0 +/- 0.2 min
Repeat until five portal cycles have been completed.
verify an enchantment density of 60 +/- 3 AM/ch3
record the circular mean, H0, to the nearest 0.1 spectral degree

parameters.name: chromatic drift
parameters.description: Angular difference between initial and final hue signatures.

evidence.quote: Rate the result in accordance with the scale illustrated in Fig. 1.

classifications.label: 5A
classifications.description: All 12 runes recovered in order and chromatic drift no greater than 1.0 spectral degree.

classifications.label: 4A
classifications.description: One outer rune may be faint or delayed, none omitted, and chromatic drift no greater than 3.0 spectral degrees.

classifications.label: 3A
classifications.description: One rune omitted or substituted, or two displaced, with chromatic drift no greater than 6.0 spectral degrees.

classifications.label: 2A
classifications.description: Two or three runes omitted, substituted, or displaced, without unsolicited sequence.

classifications.label: 1A
classifications.description: Four to eight runes not recovered in assigned positions, or one unsolicited sequence.

classifications.label: 0A
classifications.description: Fewer than four reference runes recovered, or a persistent unrelated whisper.

methods.name: Lattice-Whisper Transit Test
methods.applicability: A six-cell whisper lattice in similarly charged moon-glass vessels.

conditions.name: referenced Method A transit conditions
conditions.raw_value: conditions specified in 8.6 with recovery specified in 8.7

evidence.quote: using the conditions specified in 8.6, and allow the specimen to recover as specified in 8.7
Expose the specimen to five portal cycles
Measure initial enchantment density at the center of each cell.

parameters.name: rune loss, substitution, migration, or duplication

evidence.quote: inspect each cell for rune loss, substitution, migration, or duplication
Rate the result in accordance with the scale illustrated in Fig. 2.

classifications.label: 5B
classifications.description: All six cells retain all three runes in order and no rune crosses a cell boundary.

classifications.label: 4B
classifications.description: One faint rune and less than 5 percent of total lattice content affected.

classifications.label: 3B
classifications.description: One or two runes lost or displaced and 5 to 15 percent affected.

classifications.label: 2B
classifications.description: Three to six runes affected and 15 to 35 percent affected.

classifications.label: 1B
classifications.description: Seven to twelve runes affected, or an entire cell lost, and 35 to 65 percent affected.

classifications.label: 0B
classifications.description: More than 65 percent affected or cell boundaries no longer distinguishable.
